blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods enable efficient reconstruction of 3D scenes from sparse multi-view images in a single forward pass, without scene-specific optimization. However, existing feed-forward scene-coding pipelines first generate a complete Gaussian representation and then encode its geometry and appearance attributes separately, often involving non-differentiable operations. The resulting 'generate-then-compress' pipeline requires complex attribute-specific codec designs and limits rate-distortion performance by restricting the exploitation of cross-attribute redundancy. We propose multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS), an end-to-end feed-forward framework for scene coding. Instead of compressing an explicit Gaussian representation, MFGS extracts multi-view features from the input images and encodes them into a compact bitstream. Through end-to-end rate-distortion training, MFGS learns compact multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance, enabling the receiver to predict Gaussian attributes from the decoded features. We further introduce importance-guided Gaussian selection to accommodate different rendering budgets, allowing the receiver to adjust the number of Gaussians used for rendering from the same bitstream. Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS achieves 99.76-99.86% bitrate savings over the generate-then-compress pipeline, as measured by BD-rate, while reducing total GMACs by 52-55% and providing an approximately 12 times end-to-end speedup.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)方法使得3D场景能够从一个单一的前进通道中从稀少的多视图图像中高效重建,而无需对场景进行特定优化. 然而,现有的向前进的场景编码管道首先会产生完整的高斯代表,然后将其几何和外观属性分别编码,经常涉及无差别的操作. 由此产生的"基因-当时压缩"管道需要复杂的属性特定编码设计,并通过限制跨属性冗余的利用来限制速率扭曲性能. 我们提出高斯电镀(MFGS)的多视图特性编码,这是场景编码的端到端的feed-forward框架. MFGS没有压缩明确的高斯代表,而是从输入图像中提取多视图特征,并将其编码为紧凑的位流. 通过端到端速率扭曲训练,MFGS学习了能共同代表几何和外观的紧凑的多视图特性,使接收器能够从解码特性中预测高斯属性. 我们进一步引入了重要性引导高斯选择,以适应不同的渲染预算,允许接收器调整用于从同一位流渲染的高斯人数量. 通过RE10K,ACID,以及DL3DV,MFGS在生成-当时压缩管道上实现了99.76-99.86%的比特率节约,以BD-速率衡量,同时将GMAC总量减少52-55%,提供大约12倍的端到端速度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis with real-time rendering, but its large explicit representations incur substantial storage and transmission costs. Optimization-based 3DGS compression methods ( Chen et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Navaneet et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) , which optimize Gaussian representations for each scene, achieve strong rate–distortion performance at the cost of time-consuming iterative optimization. This limits their applicability to live applications that require rapid reconstruction and transmission of newly captured scenes.
blocks.zh: 3D Gaussian Splating (3DGS)(Kerbl等, 2023年)能以实时渲染来进行高质量的小说-视野合成,但其庞大的显式表示需要大量的存储和传输费用. 基于优化的3DGS压缩方法(Chen等,2024a; Chen等,2025b; Wang等,2024b; Navaneet等,2024; Wang等,2024a),优化了每个场景的高斯表现,以耗时的迭代优化为代价实现了强速-扭曲性能. 这限制了它们适用于需要快速重建和传送新捕获场景的现场应用.

blocks.en: Feed-forward methods ( Charatan et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024b ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) address this limitation by reconstructing Gaussian representations directly from sparse input views in a single pass. Scene transmission then follows the ‘generate-then-compress’ pipeline in Figure 1 , which encodes the predicted Gaussian attributes through specialized coding paths. For example, FCGS ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , a representative feed-forward 3DGS compression model, uses G-PCC ( Schwarz et al., 2019 ) for positions and learned coding for the remaining attributes. This separation complicates the architecture and limits joint compression of shared geometry and appearance information, while non-differentiable operations hinder end-to-end rate–distortion training. FCGS also requires repeated spatial and channel context evaluations over per-Gaussian latents and sequential decoding across context groups, increasing coding latency.
blocks.zh: 饲料前进方法(Charatan等,2024;Chen等,2024b;Xu等,2025;Liu等,2025;Zhang等,2025)通过在单行道上直接从稀疏的输入观点来重建高斯表达方式来弥补这一限制. 然后,场景传输遵循图1中的 " 基因-当时压缩 " 管道,该管道通过专门的编码路径编码预测的高斯人属性。 例如,具有代表性的FCGS(Chen等,2025a),即向导3DGS压缩模型,将G-PCC(Schwarz等,2019年)用于位置并学习了剩余属性的编码. 这种分离使架构复杂化并限制了共享几何和外观信息的联合压缩,而无差别的操作会阻碍端到端速率-扭曲训练. FCGS还要求对每名广西人的潜在情况进行反复的空间和信道上下文评价,并按顺序进行各上下文组的解码,从而增加编码间隔。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Comparison of 3D scene coding pipelines. (a) Generate-then-compress predicts explicit Gaussians and encodes their attributes through specialized paths, limiting joint compression of geometry and appearance. Non-differentiable operations such as G-PCC also hinder end-to-end training. (b) The MFGS framework compresses multi-view features with an established learned image codec and predicts Gaussian attributes from the decoded features at the receiver. This unified path simplifies coding, exploits cross-attribute redundancy, and enables end-to-end rate–distortion training, while compact latent grids reduce computation.

blocks.en: We propose the multi-view feature coding for Gaussian splatting (MFGS) framework for end-to-end feed-forward 3D scene coding. Our base model, MFGS-Base , encodes multi-view features and predicts all Gaussian attributes from the decoded features at the receiver ( Figure 1 ). Each feature plane has the same 3D tensor structure as an image, allowing us to use an established learned image codec. The shared coding path simplifies the architecture and exploits redundancy between geometry and appearance. Together with end-to-end joint rate–distortion training, this design improves rate–distortion performance while reducing computation, memory usage, and runtime relative to the generate-then-compress baseline ( Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们提出高斯电镀(MFGS)框架的多视图特性编码,用于端到端的feed-forward 3D场景编码. 我们的基础模型MFGS-Base 编码了多视图特性,并从接收器的解码特性中预测出所有高斯属性(图1). 每个特性平面都具有和图像相同的3D等分机结构,让我们可以使用一个已建立的已学习到的图像编码器. 共享的编码路径简化了架构,并利用了几何和外观的冗余. 这种设计与端到端联合速率-扭曲训练相结合,提高了速率-扭曲性能,同时相对生成-当时压缩基线(图2)降低了计算,内存使用和运行时间.

blocks.en: Receiver devices vary in computational capacity, while interactive viewing requires rendering within a per-frame time budget. To accommodate these constraints, our adaptive model, MFGS-Adaptive , combines importance-guided bit allocation with receiver-side Gaussian selection. At each rate point, the receiver can adjust the number of rendered Gaussians from a single bitstream to match its rendering capacity.
blocks.zh: 接收器设备在计算能力上各有不同,而交互式取景则需要在每帧时间预算范围内渲染. 为了适应这些限制,我们的适应模型MFGS-Adaptive结合了重要引导的位分配和接收方高斯的选择. 在每个速率点,接收器可以从一个单一比特流来调整制成高斯人的数量来配合其渲染能力.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce the MFGS framework as an alternative to generate-then-compress for feed-forward 3D scene coding. By encoding multi-view features and reconstructing Gaussians at the receiver, the framework unifies attribute-specific coding paths, enabling joint compression of geometry and appearance and end-to-end rate–distortion optimization. • We instantiate the proposed framework in the MFGS-Base model and demonstrate substantial bitrate savings together with lower computation, peak GPU memory, and runtime than the generate-then-compress baseline across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV. The joint reduction in bitrate and processing time supports the potential of multi-view feature coding for 3D live streaming. • We extend the baseline with the MFGS-Adaptive model, enabling receiver-side adjustment of the number of rendered Gaussians from a single bitstream. Experiments demonstrate limited quality degradation across rendering budgets, allowing a shared bitstream to serve receivers with different rendering capacities.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们引入了MFGS框架作为生成-当时-压缩的替代,用于feed-forward 3D场景编码. 通过编码多视图特性并重建接收器上的高斯人,框架统一了属性特定编码路径,使得能联合压缩几何和外观,并实现端到端速率-扭曲优化. ^ 我们在MFGS-Base模型中即时分析拟议框架,并显示大量的比特率节约,同时显示较低的计算,最高峰GPU内存,以及运行时间比RE10K、ACID和DL3DV的生成-当时压缩基线还要快. 联合减少比特率和处理时间,支持了3D直播流的多视图特性编码的潜力. ^ 我们用MFGS-Adapitive模型延长基线,使接收方能够调整从单一比特流得到的高斯人的数量。 实验表明,提供预算的质量退化有限,使共享的比特流能够为具有不同提供能力的接收者服务。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Optimization-based 3DGS compression
blocks.zh: 2.1 基于优化的3DGS压缩

blocks.en: Optimization-based 3DGS compression methods optimize a compact Gaussian representation separately for each scene. HAC ( Chen et al., 2024a ) models the relationship between unstructured anchors and a structured hash grid, while HAC++ ( Chen et al., 2025b ) further captures dependencies among attributes within each anchor. ContextGS ( Wang et al., 2024b ) introduces a hierarchical autoregressive context model across anchor levels. CompGS ( Navaneet et al., 2024 ) applies K-means-based vector quantization while optimizing the Gaussian parameters, whereas RDO-Gaussian ( Wang et al., 2024a ) combines pruning and entropy-constrained vector quantization under a rate–distortion objective. These methods achieve strong compression performance but require scene-specific optimization, limiting their use in live applications.
blocks.zh: 基于优化的3DGS压缩方法优化了每个场景的紧凑高斯表现. HAC (Chen等, 2024a) 模拟了无结构锚地与结构化散列网的关系,而HAC++ (Chen等人,2025b.)进一步捕捉到每个锚的属性之间的依赖性。 上下文GS(Wang等,2024b)引入了跨锚层的分级自递上下文模式. CompGS(Navaneet等人,2024年)在优化高斯参数的同时应用了以K- means为基础的矢量量化,而RDO-Gausian(Wang等人,2024年a)则在速率-分解目标下结合了穿刺和肽-受约束的矢量量化. 这些方法实现了强大的压缩性能,但需要针对场景的优化,限制了其在活性应用中的使用.

blocks.en: 2.2 Feed-forward 3DGS generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 3DGS生产

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3DGS methods predict explicit Gaussian primitives from input multi-view images without per-scene optimization. pixelSplat ( Charatan et al., 2024 ) models Gaussian depth using a probabilistic parameterization, while MVSplat ( Chen et al., 2024b ) estimates depth using plane-sweep cost volumes. DepthSplat ( Xu et al., 2025 ) further combines multi-view cost volumes with features from a pretrained monocular depth model. MonoSplat ( Liu et al., 2025 ) adapts monocular depth features into multi-view representations, whereas TranSplat ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) combines confidence-guided feature matching with monocular depth priors. ZPressor ( Wang et al., 2025 ) aggregates information from support views into a compact anchor-view latent representation, improving scalability to dense input views.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 3DGS方法从输入多视图图像中预测出明显的高斯原始人,而无需对每个场景进行优化. pixelSplatz (Charatan等, 2024年) 使用概率参数化模型Gaussian深度,而MVSplatz (Chen等, 2024b) 使用平面-扫荡成本量估算深度. DepthSplatz (Xu等,2025年)进一步将多景成本量与从预先训练出单相深度模型的特征相融合. MonoSplatz (Liu等,2025年)将单向深度特征调整为多视图表达,而TranSplatz (Zhang等,2025年)将置信导特征与单向深度前作相匹配. ZPressor(Wang等,2025年)将来自支持视角的信息汇总成紧凑的锚地-视野潜在代表,将可扩展性提升到密集输入视图.

blocks.en: 2.3 Feed-forward 3DGS compression
blocks.zh: 2.3 Feed-forward 3DGS 压缩

blocks.en: FCGS ( Chen et al., 2025a ) encodes an existing Gaussian representation without scene-specific fine-tuning using a multi-path entropy module and inter- and intra-Gaussian context models. The MPEG-GSC test model TMCV ( Ricard et al., 2025 ) also provides coding tools for explicit Gaussian parameters. These codecs retain the generated Gaussians as the coded representation, so coding operates on explicit geometry and appearance attributes. In contrast, our approach moves coding before Gaussian prediction and jointly compresses the shared information in an image-like multi-view feature representation.
blocks.zh: FCGS(Chen等,2025a.)用多路径 en模和高斯人间和内地上下文模型编码了现有的高斯人代表作,没有进行场景特异性的微调. MPEG-GSC测试模型TMCV(Ricard等,2025年)也为明确的高斯参数提供编码工具. 这些编码器保留了所生成的高斯人作为被编码的表示,因此编码在明显的几何和外观属性上运作. 相比之下,我们的方法在高斯预测之前移动了编码,并联合将共享的信息压缩在一个像图像的多视图特征代表中.

blocks.en: 2.4 Gaussian pruning
blocks.zh: 2.4 高斯跑道

blocks.en: Gaussian pruning reduces the number of primitives, thereby lowering storage and rasterization costs. LightGaussian ( Fan et al., 2024 ) ranks Gaussians using a global significance score computed over the training views and removes the least significant primitives. It then recovers rendering quality through SH distillation with pseudo views and applies vector quantization. PUP-3DGS ( Hanson et al., 2025 ) uses a second-order approximation of reconstruction sensitivity with respect to the spatial parameters of each Gaussian and applies a multi-round prune–refine procedure. EcoSplat ( Park et al., 2025 ) introduces a two-stage training scheme for feed-forward 3DGS. It first learns pixel-aligned Gaussian prediction and then ranks and adjusts the predicted primitives according to a target primitive count.

blocks.en: 2.5 Learned image compression
blocks.zh: 2.5 学习图像压缩

blocks.en: Learned image compression uses neural analysis and synthesis transforms, quantized latent representations, and entropy models trained under a rate–distortion objective. The scale hyperprior model ( Ballé et al., 2018 ) predicts spatially varying scale parameters for the latent distribution. Joint autoregressive and hierarchical priors ( Minnen et al., 2018 ) combine a hierarchical prior with causal autoregressive context to improve entropy modeling. Attention-based image compression ( Cheng et al., 2020 ) uses discretized Gaussian mixture likelihoods to model the latent distribution. AuxT ( Li et al., 2025 ) introduces wavelet-based linear shortcuts that support feature decorrelation and energy modulation, accelerating the training of nonlinear transforms.
blocks.zh: 所学的图像压缩使用神经分析和合成转换,量化潜在表达,以及按速率-扭曲目标训练的 en模型. 比例尺超前模型(Ballé等,2018年)预测了潜在分布的空间差异尺度参数. 联合自递和分级前缀(Minnen等,2018年)结合了分级前缀和因果自递上下文,来改进 en模型. 基于注意的图像压缩(Cheng等,2020年)使用盘状高斯混合物的可能性来模拟潜在的分布. AuxT (Li等, 2025)引入了基于波纹的线性快捷键,支持地貌装饰和能量调制,加快了非线性变换的训练.

blocks.en: 3.2 End-to-end multi-view feature coding (MFGS-Base model)
blocks.zh: 3.2 端到端多视图特性编码(MFGS-Base模型)

blocks.en: The MFGS-Base model is designed to improve compression efficiency while simplifying the coding process. Whereas generate-then-compress pipelines encode the attributes of spatially unstructured Gaussians through separate coding paths, MFGS-Base encodes multi-view features on regular image-like grids. This representation supports a unified codec whose entropy model operates on compact, downsampled latents, reducing computation and memory usage. End-to-end rate–distortion training further enables the codec to exploit redundancy between geometry and appearance within this unified coding path.

blocks.en: We instantiate the generator with MVSplat ( Chen et al., 2024b ) , extended with ZPressor ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Regardless of the number C C of input views, ZPressor aggregates them into a fixed number V V of cluster-view planes, forming the multi-view features F F , each plane of which has the spatial dimensions H × W H\times W of the input multi-view images. Since the Gaussian prediction head produces one Gaussian per spatial location, this yields N = V ​ H ​ W N=VHW Gaussians, independent of C C . We denote the generator’s multi-view feature extractor and Gaussian prediction head by f f and ψ \psi , respectively. The MFGS-Base model inserts a multi-view feature codec at the interface between them: the sender applies f f and encodes F F , while the receiver decodes F ^ \hat{F} and applies ψ \psi to obtain G ^ = ψ ⁡ ( F ^ ) \hat{G}=\psi(\hat{F}) for rendering. More architectural details are deferred to Section A.1 .

blocks.en: Each multi-view feature plane is a three-dimensional tensor indexed by channel, height, and width, with the same regular spatial layout as an image. This allows us to use an established learned image codec, specifically the mean-scale hyperprior (MSH) of Minnen et al. (2018) , extended with AuxT ( Li et al., 2025 ) . To accommodate the multi-view features, we adjust the input channels of the analysis transform g a g_{a} and the output channels of the synthesis transform g s g_{s} from three RGB channels to 133 feature channels. The spatial transform structure and hyperprior entropy model are retained. We apply the same codec to all feature planes and train it under the end-to-end rate–distortion objective.

blocks.en: The MFGS-Adaptive model extends MFGS-Base to accommodate receivers with different rendering capacities. Unlike post-hoc pruning, it jointly optimizes feature coding, budget-conditioned reconstruction, and Gaussian selection using the additional modules shown in green in Figure 3 . Training across keep ratios k ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] k\in(0,1] limits quality degradation as the rendering budget decreases. At each trained rate point, the bitstream remains independent of k k , allowing the receiver to adjust rendering cost after transmission.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en:
We train the MFGS-Base and MFGS-Adaptive models on RealEstate10K (RE10K) ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) using 12 input views and 8 target views per scene at a resolution of 256 × 256 256\times 256 .
We evaluate the trained checkpoints in-domain on RE10K and conduct cross-dataset evaluation without dataset-specific fine-tuning on ACID ( Liu et al., 2021 ) and DL3DV ( Ling et al., 2024 ) , using 8 input views for RE10K and ACID and 12 for DL3DV, with 8 target views for all three datasets.
We train each model separately for each λ ∈ { 0.0256 , 0.1024 , 0.4096 , 1.6384 } \lambda\in\{0.0256,0.1024,0.4096,1.6384\} . By default, we use 6 cluster views, yielding 393,216 Gaussians per scene. We report PSNR, LPIPS, arithmetic-coded bitstream size, and BD-rate ( Bjøntegaard, 2001 ) . Additional evaluation details are provided in Section A.3 .

blocks.en: We compare the complexity of the MFGS-Base model and the MVSplat+FCGS generate-then-compress pipeline ( Table 2 ), with Gaussian generation by MVSplat+ZPressor included in the baseline encoding stage. For MVSplat+FCGS, runtime includes G-PCC execution, whereas all other reported complexity metrics—GMACs, peak GPU memory, and parameter counts—exclude G-PCC. Since G-PCC performs non-learned geometry coding, parameter counts alone do not characterize the complexity of the complete pipeline. Despite the exclusion of G-PCC from the non-runtime metrics, MFGS-Base requires less than half the combined encoding and decoding GMACs and reduces peak GPU memory by approximately 60 60 – 70 % 70\% across the two stages, averaged over the three datasets. MFGS-Base also achieves an approximately 12 × 12\times end-to-end speedup. These gains reflect the structure of entropy modeling in MFGS-Base, which predicts entropy parameters for all main-latent locations in a single pass over compact, downsampled multi-view grids. In contrast, FCGS requires repeated spatial and channel context evaluations over per-Gaussian latents and sequential decoding across spatial and channel groups. A module-wise analysis and the measurement protocol are provided in Section A.7 . The substantial end-to-end speedup, combined with the bitrate savings, supports the potential of the MFGS framework for 3D live streaming, where the processing delay of generate-then-compress pipelines can limit timely reconstruction and delivery.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented the MFGS framework as an alternative to generate-then-compress for end-to-end feed-forward 3D scene coding. It encodes multi-view features that jointly represent geometry and appearance and reconstructs Gaussians from the decoded features at the receiver. The MFGS-Base model uses an established learned image codec to exploit cross-attribute redundancy through end-to-end rate–distortion training. This design improves compression efficiency while reducing computation, memory usage, and runtime. The MFGS-Adaptive model further enables the receiver to adjust the number of rendered Gaussians from a single bitstream at each trained rate point, accommodating different rendering capacities with limited quality degradation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了MFGS框架,作为生成-当时-压缩的替代品,用于端到端的feed-forward 3D场景编码. 它编码了联合代表几何和外观的多景特征并从接收器的解码特征中重建高斯人. MFGS-Base模型使用已确立的已学习到的图像编码器来通过端到端速率-扭曲性训练来利用交叉属性冗余. 这种设计提高了压缩效率,同时减少了计算,内存使用和运行时间. MFGS-Adaptive模型进一步使接收器能够从每个训练有素的收分点的单个比特流来调整制成高斯人的数量,容纳质量退化有限的不同渲染能力.

blocks.en: Across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, MFGS-Base achieves an approximately 500 × 500\times bitrate reduction based on average BD-rate, roughly halves total GMACs, and runs about 12 × 12\times faster end to end than the generate-then-compress baseline. This bitrate advantage also extends to other Gaussian generators, suggesting that the effectiveness of the MFGS framework is not tied to a specific generator. At reduced rendering budgets, MFGS-Adaptive preserves quality more effectively than the evaluated post-hoc pruning methods, even when retaining only 20 % 20\% of the Gaussians. These results support the MFGS framework as a promising approach to low-latency 3D scene delivery.
blocks.zh: 纵观RE10K,ACID,和DL3DV,MFGS-Base根据平均BD-速率实现约500×500\的比特率还原,大约将总的GMAC减半,运行约12×12\的结束速度快于生成-当时压缩基线. 这种比特率优势也扩展到了其他高斯发电机,表明MFGS框架的有效性没有被绑定在特定的发电机上. 在削减的渲染预算上,MFGS-Adaptive比评估的热量后穿梭方法更有效保存了质量,即使只保留了高斯人20%的20%. 这些成果支持了MFGS框架,认为这是低常态三维场景交付的有希望的方法.

blocks.en: 6 Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 未来工作

blocks.en: These findings are based on sparse input views at low resolution, primarily in a narrow-angle setting, and extending the framework to higher resolutions and wider camera coverage requires further investigation. Since the multi-view features are learned jointly with the Gaussian generator, deploying the framework with a different generator also requires offline retraining. At reduced rendering budgets, MFGS-Adaptive still predicts the full Gaussian candidate set before selection, so lowering the keep ratio reduces rendering cost but not decoding cost; decoding strategies whose computation scales with the rendering budget would remove this overhead. Finally, because the multi-view features share the regular layout of images, the framework extends naturally to video coding, where temporal prediction and entropy modeling could exploit redundancy across multi-view features over time.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果基于低分辨率、主要在狭长角度上很少的输入观点,将框架扩大到更高分辨率和更广泛的相机覆盖范围需要进一步调查。 由于多视图特性是与高斯生成器共同学习的,因此用不同的生成器部署框架也需要离线再培训. 在削减渲染预算时,MFGS-Adaptive仍然在选择前预测高斯人的全部候选人,因此降低保持比例会降低渲染成本而不会解码成本;解码策略,其计算比额表与渲染预算将去除这一间接费用. 最后,由于多视图特征共享图像的正则布局,框架自然延伸至视频编码,在视频编码中,时间预测和演算可以随着时间的推移利用多视图特征的冗余.

blocks.en: A.1 Architecture details

blocks.en: The multi-view feature extractor uses UniMatch [ Xu et al., 2023 ] features and six transformer blocks. ZPressor projects the cost-volume representation to 128 multi-view feature channels and concatenates RGB, disparity, and the maximum depth probability, yielding F ∈ ℝ V × 133 × H × W F\in\mathbb{R}^{V\times 133\times H\times W} . The Gaussian prediction head refines these multi-view features with a U-Net and predicts Gaussian attributes, disparity corrections, and density values that are mapped to opacity. A camera-based Gaussian adapter converts depth and image-plane offsets into world-space centers and transforms the predicted scales and rotations into world-space covariances. Tables 3 and 4 summarize the multi-view feature codec and the additional modules used in MFGS-Adaptive.

blocks.en: Even within the learned modules, parameter count alone does not determine computational cost. Weights are reused at each spatial location, so a small network can be expensive when applied repeatedly. For example, the hyperprior synthesis transform h s h_{s} contains nearly 60 % 60\% of MFGS-Base’s decoding parameters but accounts for only 2 % 2\% of its decoding GMACs. A single evaluation of h s h_{s} predicts the entropy parameters for all main-latent locations on compact, downsampled grids (see Section A.8 for their sizes). FCGS’s smaller entropy networks process per-Gaussian latents and spatial/channel contexts across a much larger set of primitives. During decoding, spatial contexts are updated using previously decoded Gaussian groups, while channel contexts depend on preceding channel groups. This entropy-model cost dominates the profiled FCGS decoding GMACs even without G-PCC, explaining why MFGS-Base can use more learned parameters yet require less computation.

blocks.en: Peak memory also depends on intermediate tensors and temporary workspaces. Avoiding FCGS’s Gaussian-domain context grids and per-Gaussian entropy tensors reduces these working-memory demands. The additional model weights occupy only tens of MiB, whereas the measured stage peaks decrease by several GiB. Raw tensor sizes alone do not determine peak memory, and our measurements do not isolate the contribution of each allocation. blocks.en: To assess runtime beyond the cost of G-PCC, we subtract G-PCC encoding and decoding times, measured separately on the same 340 scenes, from the MVSplat+FCGS timings. This estimate excludes only the G-PCC executable calls and retains Gaussian generation, neural coding, geometry preprocessing, format conversion, and rendering. Averaged across RE10K, ACID, and DL3DV, the estimated full-pipeline runtime decreases from 6.41 6.41 s to 2.99 2.99 s per scene, compared with 0.52 0.52 s for MFGS-Base. The approximately 5.7 × 5.7\times speedup indicates that the runtime advantage extends beyond the cost of G-PCC.

blocks.en: We measure both methods on the same scenes and views using RTX 3090 GPUs: 100 randomly sampled test scenes from each of RE10K and ACID, and all 140 DL3DV test scenes. blocks.en: A.10 Assets and broader impact
blocks.zh: A.10 资产和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: The experiments use RE10K [ Zhou et al., 2018 ] , ACID [ Liu et al., 2021 ] , and DL3DV [ Ling et al., 2024 ] . RE10K and ACID provide camera metadata and source-video identifiers; the corresponding videos remain subject to the dataset instructions and YouTube terms. DL3DV is used under the DL3DV-10K Terms of Use. We follow the licenses and terms of the baseline implementations and do not release a new dataset.
blocks.zh: 实验使用RE10K [周等,2018],ACID [刘等,2021],和DL3DV [Ling等,2024]. RE10K和ACID提供相机元数据和源视频识别符;相机视频仍受数据集指令和YouTube术语的约束. DL3DV在DL3DV-10K使用术语下使用. 我们遵守执行基准的许可证和条件,不发布新的数据集。

blocks.en: Compact feed-forward scene transmission can reduce bandwidth and storage requirements for telepresence and immersive media. However, captured imagery may introduce privacy risks, including unauthorized scene reconstruction. Practical deployments should obtain consent for data capture, follow dataset and platform terms, and restrict access to sensitive reconstructions.
blocks.zh: 紧凑的向前传输场景可以减少带宽和对远程存在和浸入介质的存储要求. 然而,被捕获的图像可能会带来隐私风险,包括未经授权的现场重建. 实际部署应获得数据采集的同意,遵循数据集和平台术语,并限制敏感重建的获取。
